data.title: 妮姆芙 · 散乱床单上的眼角水光
data.description: 静谧的日式居室内，妮姆芙娇小的身躯陷在柔软蓬松的被窝中。浅蓝色的双马尾散乱在纯白枕头上，透明如蝉翼的电子光子羽翼在身后泛着微弱幽蓝光芒。她身着轻薄的淡蓝色蕾丝睡衣，纤细的手指轻捏着被角，眼角蓄着动情与释怀的晶莹泪光，向你展露出卸下“电子战用天使”沉重枷锁后的纯真笑容。
data.location: cozy quiet bedroom with drawn curtains
data.action: lying curled in white bed, sheer pastel blue nightshirt, transparent glowing holographic angel wings resting on mattress, tear of relief in eye, blushing smile looking at viewer
data.lighting: soft blue holographic wing luminescence mixed with warm bedside lamp
data.mood: profound emotional rescue, delicate tearful gratitude and love
data.promptProse: Curled in a soft white bed, Nymph wears a sheer pastel blue nightshirt as her transparent holographic angel wings glow softly. A tear of relief sparkles in her cyan eyes as she smiles with pure, touching devotion.
data.animaCaption: Nymph curled in bed with glowing transparent wings, smiling through happy tears.
